game_concept: A arcade set in Eldritch Ruins – Overgrown Archway, a vine-choked archway: the rune scholar must handle vine horrors while practicing lists. Core idea – Backpack Append: Use append and remove to manage the rune scholar's backpack list as vine horrors drop loot.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Overgrown Archway: a vine-choked archway
core_gameplay_loop: In Overgrown Archway, repeat each round: Use append and remove to manage the rune scholar's backpack list as vine horrors drop loot. Each round, a new carved tiles challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the bag_space value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 100 points of carved tiles by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 1 (intro tier): Backpack Append
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Backpack Append' (Week 7 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Overgrown Archway'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bag_space changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vine horrors in Overgrown Archway.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 30 seconds.
